author: Bobby Grayson

metadata.prompt:
I want to do an experiment. I want to seamlessly replace some of the commands we use in the packaged library of deciduous to be called from an elixir binary. I want to swap out parts of deciduous's CLI with Elixir tools. We will start with something very simple: the command to get deciduous's list of nodes, `deciduous nodes`. Let's generate an elixir project and start off by trying to accomplish that by building a binary in elixir that we compile as a release and once completed can execute that kind of action. We will not want to use mix because it needs to be portable. Once you generate the elixir project, stop and I will add a lot of guardrails for you for code quality.

ok so now wire it in so deciduous itself uses this to run the nodes command. bake it into the entire build system on GH and everything and lets try a demo of it actually working this way locally shoving it into our own $PATH using the installer from brew or whatever being modified to handle this

title: Elixir binary integration into deciduous CLI
